canon.note: Fire Nihility; every hit scales off Max HP (no ATK). Ult Fornax Ex Corpore deals no direct damage: it binds enemies, pays 20% Max HP and deploys a Zone that flips him into Infinite Fury with a fixed-SPD 70 countdown unit.

fixtures.env: Mortenax Blade E0 solo vs a Fire-weak Elite, 6 cycles. Energy starts full so the A0 overflow pool banks 20 per Basic until 80; the Ult then deploys the Zone (Balefire Bind on the enemy, Infinite Fury, a spd-70 countdown), the in-Zone Skill A Rain of Blades Seals Fate fires, and energy refilling to cap triggers the in-Zone Ult Tenax Per Ignem.
Mortenax Blade E1 solo vs the same Elite, 6 cycles. E1 Ere My Death shreds enemy All-Type RES (mb_e1, resAll -20%) while the Zone is active and delays the countdown by 15% when the extra Skill fires.

requirements.claim: Basic ATK A Broken Blade Still Slays (150701) deals a single-target Fire hit scaled off Max HP while outside Infinite Fury.
Ultimate Fornax Ex Corpore (150703) resolves as a normal 'ult' action (it deals no direct damage; it deploys the Zone).
While the Zone is deployed Mortenax enters Infinite Fury (mb_fury: CRIT Rate ult_a2, CRIT DMG ult_a3).
Talent All Karma Comes Due: while the Zone is active, Fornax Ex Corpore inflicts Balefire Bind on every enemy (mb_bind: DEF ult_a7, DMG taken ult_a4) for ult_a8 (=2) turns.
Entering Infinite Fury registers a fixed-SPD (ult_a5=70) countdown unit on the action order; its turn dispels the Zone.
In-Zone Skill A Rain of Blades Seals Fate is an AoE main hit (skill) plus 4 random instances (skill_a2), scaled off Max HP by 10%.

of.label: A Rain of Blades Seals Fate (main)

requirements.claim: Inside the Zone the Ultimate becomes Tenax Per Ignem (150714), an AoE Fire hit scaled off Max HP at ult_en.
E1 Ere My Death applies All-Type RES down (modelled as mb_e1, resAll -0.2) to enemies while the Zone is active.
